fields.description: Weekly issue featuring Miami social and sports commentary, including extensive horse-racing coverage and betting/handicapping content (Tropical Park and upcoming Hialeah meet) with warnings about unauthorized sale of selections. Includes local opinion pieces and gossip-style columns ("They Tell Me," "Things I'd Like to Know"), discussion of Florida politics and regional power, and numerous advertisements for bars, restaurants, liquor-related events (International Wine and Liquor Exposition), and local businesses.
